summary: Clackamas County site: a Forest Service crow's nest and tent about 1925, a timber tower by about 1935 (110 or 82 ft, sources differ), gone by 1960.

facts.design: Tree crow's nest and tent (c.1925), then a treated timber tower by c.1935; 110 ft per FFLOS, 82 ft L-6 per firelookout.com
facts.status_note: Tower gone by 1960 per both sources; no source describes remains at the site
facts.agency: U.S. Forest Service, Mount Hood National Forest

events.note: Crow's nest and tent constructed by the Forest Service (firelookout.com lists a crow's nest and camp)
Panorama photos entry dated June 20, 1934, per the Oregon Lookouts page
Replaced by a treated timber tower: 110 ft per FFLOS, 82 ft L-6 per firelookout.com
Tower gone by 1960; neither source says how it came down
Registered with the Former Fire Lookout Sites register August 16, 2010 (US 562, OR 3)

evidence.supports: c.1925 tree crow's nest and tent by the Forest Service; replaced c.1935 by a 110-foot treated timber tower; gone by 1960
evidence.quote: Around 1925 a tree crow's nest and a tent were constructed by the Forest Service. This was replaced around 1935 with a 110' treated timber tower, which was gone by 1960.

evidence.supports: 1925 crow's nest and camp; 1935 82-foot treated timber L-6 tower; gone 1960
evidence.quote: 1925: crows nest, camp. 1935: 82' treated timber L-6 tower. Gone 1960.

evidence.supports: About 15 miles west-northwest of Mount Hood
Listed under Mt Hood National Forest entry
Administered by the U.S. Forest Service

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Both sources date a timber tower to about 1935 but give different heights: 110 feet (FFLOS) and 82 feet (firelookout.com). The story gives both figures and does not pick one.
FFLOS describes a tree crow's nest and a tent; firelookout.com describes a crow's nest and camp for the same date. The story reports the FFLOS wording and notes firelookout.com's version.

corrections.current: Sources disagree on whether a tower or building stood here, or only a camp or lookout tree.
corrections.proposed: Both sources date a timber tower to about 1935; they disagree on its height (110 ft vs 82 ft) and on the 1925 structure (crow's nest and tent vs crow's nest and camp).
corrections.why: Both sources agree a timber tower stood here about 1935. The real disagreement is height and the description of the 1925 structure, not whether a tower existed.

notes_for_editor: Height conflict (110 ft FFLOS vs 82 ft firelookout.com) is unresolved; no newspaper or Forest Service record was consulted. The brief's elevation 1159.2 m matches firelookout.com's 3803 ft. The FFLOS page carries a photo captioned 'Aschoff Butte Lookout 1925 - 1935 - courtesy of Howard Verschoor collection', but no image URL was extracted, so it is not in photos. The 'June 20, 1934: Panorama photos' entry may belong to the 1933-35 Forest Service panorama survey described by The Nature Conservancy's Osborne pages (which do not name Aschoff); checking that photo table would confirm the date. Its access and remains are not described by any source read.
